headline: Tax authority 'cracks down' on businesses reporting thin profits or persistent losses
summary: The tax authority has asked audit firms and tax agents to uphold professional ethics and not abet fraud. It targets entities that report persistent losses or profits below industry averages.
why: Tax enforcement against loss-reporting firms affects corporate tax revenue and compliance costs for auditors and listed companies operating in Vietnam.
